notes: IFRS 4 basis. NIS thousand as printed. Liabilities: note 15 (not yield-dependent) and note 16 (yield-dependent), row "חוזי השקעה", gross columns. Note 16 is printed with the liability of the year and the prior year-end; the FY2024 and FY2023 balances are taken.
Note 18 also prints total investment-contract liabilities by exposure (8,329,561 at 31.12.2024, not extracted as a fact).
Receipts from the notes: FY2024 3,208,360; FY2023 1,455,486; FY2022 2,152,388 (NIS thousand). The directors' report footnote in the annual report rounds to NIS 3,208 million / 1,455 million.
